subtitle: J198/01 Section C: Athens in the Age of Pericles, 462–429 BC
shortTitle: Athens in the Age of Pericles
disclaimer: Aligned to Cambridge OCR GCSE (9–1) Ancient History (J198). Independent educational resource by The History Revision Hub; not endorsed by Cambridge OCR.

topics.title: Ephialtes, Pericles, Ecclesia and Boule
points: Citizenship after the reforms of Ephialtes and Pericles; the workings of the ecclesia, boule, archontes and strategoi; the role of Sophists; ostracism in removing Cimon and Thucydides

sections.title: Athens, Sparta and Pericles' Foreign Policy

topics.title: Delian League, Megarian Decree and Archidamian War
points: Refusal of Athenian help suppressing the helot revolt, construction of the Long Walls; the Delian League and Athenian Empire; Pericles' strategy during the Archidamian War and the plague

sections.title: Pericles and cultural and religious life in Athens

topics.title: Acropolis Building Programme and Festivals
points: The importance of Pericles' building programme; criticisms of the building programme and trial of Pheidias; the Panathenaia and City Dionysia; Funeral Oration

topics.title: Citizen Women, Medea, Arrephoroi and Aspasia
points: Role and position of women in daily life; Pericles' citizenship law; depictions of women in Medea; the Arrephoroi and Aspasia
